title: A Spectral Dichotomy for Dilworth Multiplicity Bounds of the Signless Laplacian and Distance Signless Laplacian on C-Graphs and Cographs
description: Theorem 5.8 gives upper bounds of 5k - 4 and 5k - 3 for non-local eigenvalue multiplicities of the signless Laplacian and distance signless Laplacian of connected cographs of Dilworth number k. Theorem 5.9 gives a family with multiplicity at least 4k/3 - 1 for both matrices.
